## About Me

Hi, I'm Isabela Carvajal,  I'm a graduate student in 
the Business Analytics and Marketing Analytics program at Baruch College, with a Bachelors in International 
Business and a minor in Fashion Design. 

Professionally, I have experience in:

- Finance 
- Sales
- Fashion Design

While I was doing my OPT, I saw the importance of analytics to be more efficient and break down larger data, Which sparked my interest in using data to solve real-world business problems — which is what brought me to this course.

I'm bilingual in Spanish and English, and outside of school my hobby is Golf and fashion.

*I am currently working on my own fashion brand;)*

**I look forward to connecting with everyone in the class!**
